dtsPropsFor.Pill:
/** A control status, spelled exactly as the API spells it. */
  status: "pass" | "fail" | "partial" | "not_assessed" | "not_applicable" | (string & {});
dtsPropsFor.Sev:
/** Severity rank, rendered as a filled square sized by rank. */
  severity: "critical" | "high" | "medium" | "low";
dtsPropsFor.SevRow:
/**
   * Counts keyed by severity. Absent severities are omitted, not zeroed, and an
   * empty object renders the phrase "none open" rather than an empty row.
   * The numbers themselves are a `title` tooltip, not visible text — this is a
   * glanceable density strip, so pair it with a label if the count must be read.
   */
  counts: Record<string, number>;
dtsPropsFor.Kv:
/** Label-over-value pairs. `k` is the label, `v` the value; `mono` sets a monospace value. */
  items: Array<{ k: string; v: React.ReactNode; mono?: boolean }>;
